title: Product Safety Notification and Recall Effectiveness Act of 2002
short_title: Product Safety Notification and Recall Effectiveness Act of 2002

actions.text: Sponsor introductory remarks on measure. (CR S7910)
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. (text of measure as introduced: CR S7910-7911)

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. (text of measure as introduced: CR S7910-7911)

summaries.text: Product Safety Notification and Recall Effectiveness Act of 2002 - Directs the Consumer Product Safety Commission to promulgate a rule requiring the manufacturer of specified juvenile products and small household appliances to establish and maintain a product recall notification system for consumers.Requires such system to create a database for the sole purpose of notifying such consumers of product recalls through the use of product safety owner cards (or an alternative method).
